parameters.text:
Analyze this insurance claim video. Extract these exact fields based on visual and audio context. Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown, no preamble.

Required fields:
- policy_number (string, if visible/stated)
- claimant_name (string, if visible/stated)
- claimant_phone (string or null)
- incident_date (YYYY-MM-DD format, if visible/stated)
- incident_type (one of: accident, illness, theft, damage, other)
- incident_description (string, describe what occurred, visible damage, injuries, etc.)
- claimed_amount (number, not string, if mentioned)
- provider_name (string or null, e.g. hospital sign, repair shop)
- invoice_number (string or null)

Also include:
- field_confidence (object with confidence 0.0-1.0 for each field)
- warnings (array of strings for any issues like poor lighting, unclear audio, or missing details)
